title: Audio metadata snapshot and conditional update foundation
purpose: Add canonical optimistic concurrency support for private Sesh audio metadata before exposing rename mutation.
invariants: Audio metadata snapshots expose the canonical asset and server persistence revision only to server-side operations.
New audio metadata begins at revision zero.
Conditional metadata updates require the exact current revision.
A stale revision fails with conflict and does not overwrite newer metadata.
Audio id, projectId, kind, createdAt, storageReference, contentType, durationSeconds, sampleRateHz, and channelCount are immutable through ordinary metadata updates.
The binary object store is not read, written, moved, copied, or deleted by metadata CAS.
No public URL, sharing, download, publishing, master, management, copyright, royalty, or collaborator authority is introduced.
This slice does not expose HTTP PATCH or Studio rename controls.
